packages/memory/src/index.ts.name: Markdown memory store
packages/memory/src/index.ts.description: Stores per-bot and per-Space memory documents in Postgres with revisions and optimistic-concurrency commits.

packages/adapters/src/memory/memory-tool.name: Memory edit logic
packages/adapters/src/memory/memory-tool.description: Applies add, replace and remove operations atomically with a 4 KB cap, fuzzy entry matching and tool filtering by provider.

packages/adapters/src/memory/memory-cont.name: Memory loader
packages/adapters/src/memory/memory-cont.description: Reads bot and shared memory for a run and moves entries past their end date into ARCHIVE.md first.

packages/adapters/src/memory/memory-cont.name: Memory prompt renderer
packages/adapters/src/memory/memory-cont.description: Renders memory documents into an escaped durable_memory block under a 32 KB budget, bot scope first.

packages/adapters/src/memory/memory-expi.name: Memory entry stamps
packages/adapters/src/memory/memory-expi.description: Stamps entries with saved and end dates and splits out those whose end date has passed.

packages/adapters/src/memory/memory-prov.name: Memory provider registry
packages/adapters/src/memory/memory-prov.description: Lists the five external memory providers a Space can connect, in the order offered.

packages/adapters/src/memory/memory-prov.name: Memory provider contract
packages/adapters/src/memory/memory-prov.description: Defines what each memory provider supplies: settings form, endpoint checks, credential target and factory.

packages/adapters/src/memory/memory-prov.name: Memory provider resolver
packages/adapters/src/memory/memory-prov.description: Resolves a Space's saved provider config and decrypted credentials into a semantic memory client.

packages/adapters/src/memory/conversatio.name: Conversation learning
packages/adapters/src/memory/conversatio.description: Sends finished chat turns to the memory provider with capped transcripts and purges them after a chat clear.

packages/adapters/src/runs/tools/run-too.name: Memory tool handlers
packages/adapters/src/runs/tools/run-too.description: Runs remember, recall, save, forget, reflect, search_history and read_history for a run with server-set scope.

packages/adapters/src/tools/builtin-memo.name: Memory tool schemas
packages/adapters/src/tools/builtin-memo.description: Declares search_history, read_history, email and the four semantic memory tool schemas offered to the model.

packages/adapters/src/tools/builtin-conv.name: Conversation tool schemas
packages/adapters/src/tools/builtin-conv.description: Declares the remember tool with its add, replace and remove operations and the shared flag.

packages/contracts/src/bots/bot-memory.t.name: Memory contracts
packages/contracts/src/bots/bot-memory.t.description: Defines MEMORY.md and ARCHIVE.md paths, the 4 KB bot cap and the prompt budget schemas.

packages/contracts/src/models/model-conn.name: Model connection contracts
packages/contracts/src/models/model-conn.description: Defines cache capability fields (retention, minimum tokens, costs) a model connection can declare.

packages/db/src/bots/memory-config.ts.name: Memory scope resolver
packages/db/src/bots/memory-config.ts.description: Resolves a bot's effective memory scope from its own setting or the Space default.

packages/db/src/history/history-retrieva.name: History search
packages/db/src/history/history-retrieva.description: Searches and reads earlier messages by keyword with full-text matching, scope limits and paging.

packages/adapters/src/runtime/context/co.name: Context pruning
packages/adapters/src/runtime/context/co.description: Drops stale page-state results and old tool images when the transcript is rebuilt.

packages/adapters/src/runtime/context/hi.name: History replay notes
packages/adapters/src/runtime/context/hi.description: Provides short notes used when replaying history: conversation start, dropped images, missing tools.

packages/adapters/src/runtime/context/re.name: Context window sniffing
packages/adapters/src/runtime/context/re.description: Parses context size from OpenAI-compatible server errors so the window can be lowered.

packages/adapters/src/runtime/context/co.name: Context selection
packages/adapters/src/runtime/context/co.description: Chooses which message groups fit the token budget, shortens tool results and tracks cache warmth.

packages/adapters/src/runtime/context/ru.name: Context notes
packages/adapters/src/runtime/context/ru.description: Holds snapshot catalogue text and the markers used when tool results or images are shortened.

packages/adapters/src/runtime/context/sc.name: Scratchpad renderer
packages/adapters/src/runtime/context/sc.description: Renders open scratchpad items into a 4 KB prompt block, sharing space between notes.

packages/adapters/src/runtime/context/sc.name: Scratchpad prompt text
packages/adapters/src/runtime/context/sc.description: Holds the preamble and hint strings framing the open scratchpad block as data.

packages/adapters/src/runtime/context/hi.name: History speaker labels
packages/adapters/src/runtime/context/hi.description: Labels who said each message in shared spaces and strips brackets so names cannot fake labels.

packages/adapters/src/runs/assembly/run-.name: Run records loader
packages/adapters/src/runs/assembly/run-.description: Loads the bot, thread, history window, skills, memory config and trust flags a run needs.

packages/adapters/src/runs/assembly/prom.name: Prompt version hash
packages/adapters/src/runs/assembly/prom.description: Hashes all authored prompts, tool text and context settings into a version stored on each run.

packages/adapters/src/runs/assembly/chec.name: Checkpoint answer history
packages/adapters/src/runs/assembly/chec.description: Restores question-card answers into history for a resumed paused turn.

packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/pi-runt.name: Pi history replay
packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/pi-runt.description: Converts stored history into provider messages, replaying tool steps without reusing signatures.

packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/usage/p.name: Cache retention rules
packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/usage/p.description: Validates prompt-cache retention modes per provider API and maps long retention to one-hour writes.

packages/adapters/src/tools/skill-tools..name: Skill tools
packages/adapters/src/tools/skill-tools..description: Implements skill_read, skill_create, skill_update and skill_delete over stored SKILL.md documents.

packages/adapters/src/tools/builtin-skil.name: Builtin skills
packages/adapters/src/tools/builtin-skil.description: Defines the read-only Rakazo documentation skill pointing at fixed docs URLs.

packages/core/src/skills/agent-skill.ts.name: Skill format
packages/core/src/skills/agent-skill.ts.description: Parses and builds SKILL.md files and expands /Name and @Name skill references in prompts.

packages/core/src/skills/agent-skill.pro.name: Skill catalogue prompt
packages/core/src/skills/agent-skill.pro.description: Formats the skills catalogue instruction and the forced-skill prompt wrapper.

packages/adapters/src/bots/teaching-sess.name: Skill teaching session
packages/adapters/src/bots/teaching-sess.description: Records a human demonstration on a bot's computer and turns it into a saved taught skill.

packages/adapters/src/integrations/plugi.name: Plugin skill files
packages/adapters/src/integrations/plugi.description: Identifies SKILL.md folders and companion text files in a plugin, read as text only.

packages/adapters/src/bots/agent-import-.name: Agent import mapping
packages/adapters/src/bots/agent-import-.description: Maps an imported OpenClaw, Hermes or Grok agent's routines and skills into Rakazo settings.

packages/adapters/src/tasks/scratchpad-t.name: Scratchpad store
packages/adapters/src/tasks/scratchpad-t.description: Defines scratchpad item statuses, limits and listing of a bot's open work items.

packages/adapters/src/tasks/ticket-conte.name: Ticket context
packages/adapters/src/tasks/ticket-conte.description: Finds ticket references in the prompt and renders them into a 4 KB data block.
